notes: Nothing was applied to preview or production, no workflow was dispatched, no review was dispatched and this pull request was not merged.
The reserved migration version 20260910155753 was used exactly as assigned, and no database object outside the eight claimed objects was created.

This repository is public. The migration, the tests, the manifest and the validator output contain no licensed label, row, URL, contract or raw evidence; every value in the contract test is invented (ZZTEST / example.invalid).

Three files outside the original object claim were changed because a repository guard demands it and refuses otherwise: docs/verification/throughput-guard-truth-baseline-20260828.json (detector source hash), scripts/production_business_risk_gate.py (mandatory producer-path registration) and .github/workflows/shared-supabase-migrations.yml (wiring the new validator into CI so it is a gate). None of them weakens a guard.

A defect found and fixed during implementation: the finalize loader originally recorded a completeness rejection and then raised, which would have rolled the rejection back and left the capture in 'loading'. It now returns the rejection payload, so the refusal is durable.

A second defect found and fixed: the contract test's negative check used the literal '_inferred_', which can never match the real table names ending in '_inferred'. It now names plm.wwe_asset_property_inferred, plm.wwe_character_property_inferred and plm.wwe_style_guide_property_inferred exactly.

CI repair after the first push: the api.source_capture_inventory view body still carried the `and (p_table_name is null or c.relname = p_table_name)` predicate copied from api.source_capture_inventory_exact. A view takes no parameter, so the entire migration aborted with `column "p_table_name" does not exist` and never applied. That single error produced all four database contract failures - the TrackerPlus landing tables were never created, and the pre-existing view kept classifying every plm.marvel_* and plm.wwe_* table as 'other'. The predicate was removed from the view only; the function keeps it, and no contract expectation was changed to make a test pass.

The claim on issue #2679 was amended through the supported path `--expand-active-claim-from-pr`, never by hand, adding the two TrackerPlus staff-read policies and api.source_capture_inventory as declared writes. Contract generation 2 (refs/db-contracts/2579/2) adds docs/verification/throughput-guard-truth-audit-20260828.json to allowed_paths: the truth-audit inventory needed the one new call site introduced by scripts/check-db-data-admin-property-source-coverage.mjs:188, which reports the reserved migration missing only after a direct fs.existsSync test, so it is dispositioned 'excluded'.

CI round 3: the ephemeral-database replay aborted the migration at its own append-only assertion, '#2579: 6 mutating grants survive on the TrackerPlus landing'. The count read information_schema.role_table_grants with no grantee filter, so it included the table owner's implicit UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE on both new tables (2 x 3 = 6) which no REVOKE can remove. The guard and the matching contract-test assertion now filter to service_role, authenticated, anon and PUBLIC, the same shape used by the wildbrain and sega landing guards; the guarantee is unchanged and the sidecar migration_sha256 was rebound to 9a1dfaccef8867701ace74dfdf1c5634c71bb420f98781b729f3167eb2084a2a.

CI round 4: the migration applied and the four earlier database-contract failures cleared, leaving two. opa_coherent_complete_capture_contracts A0 showed api.source_capture_inventory_exact('opa_capture_scope') reporting a zero current-snapshot count where the coherent-capture contract requires an unknown latest-complete count, because this migration's in-place rewrite of the inventory was authored against the definition that preceded 20260909115140 and dropped its OPA clock. wildbrain_nbcu_licensing_read_access C showed the two new TrackerPlus read policies no longer admitting designer, which #1249 forbids. Both were repaired in the migration rather than in the tests; no contract expectation was changed.
